questions.question: The ancient university of Nalanda was located in present-day:
questions.explanation: Nalanda is in present-day Bihar.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: The "Make in India" initiative was launched in:
questions.explanation: Make in India was launched in September 2014.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: Which element is essential for the formation of haemoglobin?
questions.explanation: Iron is essential for haemoglobin formation.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: The author of the Indian national anthem is:
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Jana Gana Mana".

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President (1950–62).

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.B: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: The Sundarbans delta is formed by which rivers?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is formed by the Ganga–Brahmaputra delta.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: Which festival is known as the "Festival of Lights"?
questions.explanation: Diwali is the Festival of Lights.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 45 days?
questions.explanation: 45 mod 7 = 3; Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 7th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 11th letter = K; 11 + 7 = 18th letter = R.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (7, 343), (6, 214), (3, 27), (2, 8)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 214.

questions.question: In a row of 55 students, Ravi is 17th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 55 − 17 + 1 = 39.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 7, 13, 21, 31, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 31 + 12 = 43.

questions.question: If LAMP is coded as MBNQ, how is DOG coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1. Applying the same to DOG gives EPH.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 6² = 36.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 11 + 2 × 5.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 11 × 2 − 5 = 22 − 5 = 17.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 5, 11, 23, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2 + 1: 23 × 2 + 1 = 47.

questions.question: Complete the series: A, C, E, G, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is I.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 18, 11, 5, 3
questions.explanation: 11, 5, 3 are prime numbers; 18 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 5th letter from the right is the 22nd from the left = V.
The relation is cubing: 4³ = 64, so 4³ = 64.

questions.question: If today is Thursday, what day will it be after 87 days?
questions.explanation: 87 mod 7 = 3; Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 13th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 13th letter = M; 13 + 8 = 21th letter = U.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (4, 64), (5, 125), (6, 217), (9, 729)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 217.

questions.question: In a row of 39 students, Ravi is 11th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 39 − 11 + 1 = 29.

questions.question: Find the next term: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 4²…8². Next is 9² = 81.

questions.question: Find the next term: 6, 10, 16, 24, 34, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 34 + 12 = 46.

questions.question: If STAR is coded as UVCT, how is RAIN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to RAIN gives TCKP.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 1:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 1:00 the angle is 1 × 30° = 30°.
The relation is squaring: 7² = 49, so 10² = 100.

questions.question: What is 15% of 440?
Find the simple interest on ₹2600 at 6% per annum for 5 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹4000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹700 is sold for ₹770.0000000000001. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹240 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 8.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their sum is 108. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 108/12 = 9. Larger = 7 × 9 = 63.

questions.question: A train 120 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 4 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/4 = 16/48. Time = 48/16 = 3 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √1369.
After a 20% discount, an item costs ₹560. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 50% of 1000.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 8 and their difference is 40. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 5 parts = 40, so each part = 8. Smaller = 3 × 8 = 24.

questions.question: A boat travels 34 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 34/2 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 4 = 13 km/h.
